verdict.rationale: Dropbox Dash provides AI-generated summaries, answers, document review, and organization suggestions from users' files (dash.dropbox.com resources), directly matching the story. However, evidence is all first-party marketing/docs with no independent or hands-on corroboration, and one homepage claim ('AI is coming to Dropbox') suggests some AI features are still rolling out rather than fully mature across the core product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of AI insight quality, clarity on which AI features are GA vs upcoming, and detail on how deeply these are integrated into core Dropbox storage vs. the separate Dash product.
